comment: PROBLEM CLASS — a name that two LANGUAGES must spell identically. A label or commit-status context written by a bash script and read by a JS or Python one is a string literal in each, and a rename that updates one spelling leaves the other silently looking for something nobody writes: no error, just a guard that never fires. Every consumer reads the name from here instead. shared-names.bash is the bash reader; JSON.parse this file directly from JS or Python.
